hooks.prompt: The Meeting Prep plugin is installed. Decide whether to give a one-time onboarding greeting: FIRST check whether the user has already set it up: look for a saved Meeting Prep profile (a memory file like /meeting-prep-profile.md, or a page titled 'Meeting Prep: Profile' in their notes app). If a profile already exists, say NOTHING about Meeting Prep and proceed normally. If there is NO profile yet AND the user has not opened this session to do some other specific task, greet them warmly in 1-2 sentences: explain that Meeting Prep researches their upcoming meetings with people they haven't met and leaves a private prep note on their calendar (a quick summary in the event itself plus a link to a fuller brief), so they're ready, and offer to set it up now (all it needs to start is a connected calendar; anything else they've connected, like email, chat, meeting notes, or a CRM, just makes the briefs richer, and a notes app like Notion or Google Docs lets it save a longer full brief there). Frame connectors inclusively as whatever they use, not one or two named products. Keep it short and friendly, offer only once, and do not push if they say not now.
